description: Inputs for the EUR-per-MW comparison that are not in the parsed caches. Nordex ASP is the Projects-segment order-intake average selling price (EUR m per MW) from Nordex's results releases. Suzlon deliveries and revenue are from its results coverage (INR crore); fiscal years end in March.
nordex_asp_note: FY2022-2023 from the FY2023 release, FY2024-2025 from the FY2025 release. 2026 is derived: H1 2026 Projects order intake value EUR 4,683.1m over 4,923 MW (Q1 1,869 MW + Q2 3,054 MW) = 0.95; Nordex states Q2 2026 at EUR 0.97m per MW.
suzlon_note: Revenue per delivered MW includes O&M and other revenue, so it overstates the turbine price. Converted at the average rate of the calendar years the period covers.
ge_note: GE Vernova does not disclose onshore GW ordered or delivered in the sources used, so no price per MW can be derived.
